business_problem: We wanted to empower all PETRONAS citizens with self-service capabilities to create a shopping-like experience when searching for data," says Habsah Nordin.
solution_summary: PETRONAS used Azure AI Search, Power BI, Power Platform to replace disconnected manual workflows with a more consistent digital operating model. Low-code automation and copilot capabilities orchestrate tasks, route work, and surface context to agents or business users without requiring separate point solutions. This platform has empowered employees with accelerated knowledge extraction and enabled enterprise analytics at scale, supporting PETRONAS' ambition of becoming a data-driven organization. The architecture emphasizes managed services, reusable integrations, and governed data handling so the organization can scale adoption without rebuilding the solution for each new team or use case.

solution_components.name: Power BI
solution_components.role: Delivers dashboards, reports, and self-service analytics to business users.

solution_components.name: Power Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the low-code automation and application platform for workflow modernization.

solution_components.name: Azure Databricks
solution_components.role: Transforms large-scale data and runs analytical or machine-learning workloads.

solution_components.name: Azure Synapse Analytics
solution_components.role: Runs integrated SQL and big-data analytics across enterprise datasets.
